messages:
jessica-cs: Quick weekly private/VPC health check — dropping region-by-region notes and action items. TL;DR: overall steady but two hotspots: eu-west KMS rotations and ap-southeast intermittent packet loss.

jessica-cs: Usage trends: 10% increase in token volume week-over-week for private customers (mostly batch inference windows). Spend: +8% primarily due to longer context lengths on customer A/B tests.

marco-tech: Latency: p50/p95 stable in us-east, slight p95 bump in eu-west on tail during rotation windows (see trace ids).

amir-sre: Error rates: 0.2% across the fleet, eu-west saw a spike to 1.4% for ~12m between 02:12-02:24 UTC yesterday. Root cause looks like transient KMS throttling.

jessica-cs: Connectivity notes: ap-southeast-1 reported 3 short infra blips. Packet loss around 0.8% for ~6m during customer backup window. corollary: some requests retried -> higher cost.

rachel-account: Any customers affected flagged for renewal risk? I flagged two accounts (acct-Delta, acct-Spectrum) for outreach — both had brief latency-sensitive outages.

liz-ops: Action item: schedule KMS key rotation cooldown window with eu-west customers. Proposed window: Sat 00:00-03:00 UTC. Need signoff from legal/compliance.

amir-sre: From logs: 
```
kms-service: WARN RequestLimitExceeded key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:... client=acct-Spectrum trace=af3c
retry attempt=1 -> success after 4s
```
Suggest adding short jitter + backoff for KMS calls in the private agent.

marco-tech: Quick config snippet to limit burst on KMS calls (we can push to private-agent 0.9.3):
```
kms:
  max_concurrent_calls: 12
  backoff:
    base_ms: 200
    max_ms: 2000
```
Would reduce throttle footprint.

jessica-cs: @amir-sre can you confirm whether HSM-backed keys exhibited the same throttling? kms-bot, did we get any HSM alerts?

kms-bot: HSM alert summary: 1 warning (eu-west) — queue depth peaked at 76% for hardware module. No HSM failures. Recommend monitoring window extended to 6h for next rotation.

amir-sre: Confirmed — HSM queue spike but no auth failures. KMS API throttles were the main error class.

rachel-account: I'll schedule outreach: offer guided rotation + 1:1 runbook review for acct-Spectrum and acct-Delta. Will mention cost mitigation tips (context length trimming, batching).

liz-ops: I'll open a short RFC for private-agent 0.9.3 to include KMS client backoff + rate limiter. Assign to marco for patch.

marco-tech: On it. Will add tests and a canary to EU region for next deploy. deploy-bot: planning canary for 2024-08-18 01:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: private-agent 0.9.3 -> eu-west-1 (10% nodes) 2024-08-18T01:00:00Z. Rollback on >0.5% error delta.

jessica-cs: Outstanding items recap: (1) RFC + patch for KMS backoff (marco), (2) extended HSM monitoring for next rotation (amir), (3) customer outreach for acct-Spectrum/Delta (rachel), (4) proposed eu-west rotation window signoff (liz/legal). I'll follow up with a short summary email.

marco-tech: ETA for PR: 48h. Will request expedited review.

amir-sre: I'll extend the HSM alarm windows and post updated dashboards link in this thread once ready.

rachel-account: Ping me when dashboard link is up and I’ll schedule customer calls.

jessica-cs: Thanks team. Low severity overall but want to close the loop before next rotation. :thumbsup:
